reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I downloaded and installed the app, and I was offered a 7or14-day free trial with the purchase of an annual plan. I was informed that I would be notified before the trial period ended and asked to confirm the payment, which I agreed to.

However, during the purchase process, there was a technical issue, and the only option available was “Restore Purchase.” I selected it, and a message appeared saying that the purchase had been restored.

I then entered the app and tested it for about 3–5 minutes. It quickly became clear that this was not what I was looking for, so I immediately canceled the subscription and deleted the app.

Despite this, I was charged for the full annual plan the very next day.

I only used the app for a few minutes, and I was clearly promised a multi-day free trial. This situation feels misleading and unacceptable.

I did not intend to use this service and have not used it beyond a brief test. I kindly request a full refund.

reviews.title: The app store should deal with this.
reviews.text:
I recently downloaded an English learning app from the App Store that claimed to offer a 7-day free trial before charging any fees. However, I was charged $35 and $29 immediately without any visible trial period, and the app does not appear in my purchase history in a way that allows cancellation.

There is no option to cancel the subscription, and I feel this is a scam. I did not intend to make a one-time purchase, and I did not authorize these charges. Please help me cancel this app and process a refund for both transactions.

I believe this app is deceptive and should be reviewed for violating Apple's policies.

Hello! We're sorry to hear you've had trouble managing your subscription.

reviews.title: Unexpected subscription charge
reviews.text:

The app automatically charged my card after the trial ended without any reminder or clear warning. I did not intend to purchase the subscription. This practice feels misleading and not user-friendly. Please improve transparency and notify users before charging.
